card.name: Fan-wiki names and dates, mid-entry
card.fires_on: Partway through proper names and years in fantasy or sci-fi wiki text, such as Harry Potter or Star Trek pages. It also fires on the gap before a year or century.

modes.label: Inside character names
modes.description: Middle of a fictional person's name, such as a surname or a name that is split up.

modes.label: Years and centuries
modes.description: A digit or space inside a year or century phrase in a story timeline.
